description:
``usage.json`` — measured model token usage and estimated cost for one run.

Written per ``run-predict`` / ``run-evaluate`` matrix cell (predictor x event
for predict, evaluator x event for evaluate) alongside that cell's prediction
or evaluation output. Token buckets follow the Claude convention:
``input_tokens`` is fresh input, with cached reads and cache writes counted
separately so ``estimated_cost_usd`` can apply the right rate to each (see
``fedcourtsai.pricing``). Summing these across runs replaces the planning
assumption with a measured \$/run.

engine_version.description: The engine CLI's version as its own binary reported it (`claude --version`, `codex --version`, `gemini --version`), read by the harness — never the agent's word. For the CLIs the harness installs (claude-code, gemini) the read is taken at install, before any agent ran; codex is installed by its action, so its read follows the run. An engine update under an unchanged process digest is composition, and this field is how a reading cuts by it. Null on records written before the field existed or when the binary's output named no version.
engine_version.title: Engine Version

engine_version_discrepancy.description: Set when the engine's version reads disagree: the binary reported a different version after the run than at install, or a version other than the pin the workflow installed from. The recorded `engine_version` is kept as read; this says the cell's engine is in doubt, and a reading cutting by engine version treats such a cell as unknown. Null when every read agrees, and on records written before the field existed.
engine_version_discrepancy.title: Engine Version Discrepancy

estimated_cost_usd.description: On-demand USD estimate from the rates in fedcourtsai.pricing
estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd

model.description: Model the cost rates were applied to (resolved, never null)
model.title: Model

pipeline_sha.description: Git commit of the pipeline checkout that ran this cell (GITHUB_SHA in CI, the local HEAD otherwise) — pins the prompt templates, harness, and registry in force at run time. Null on records written before the field existed or when unresolvable.
pipeline_sha.title: Pipeline Sha

pre_mint_poll.description: What the docket showed when the harness polled it just before a forward predict cell's record was written: the poll's UTC time and whether the event was still open. A forward cell is refused when the poll finds the outcome, so an `open` poll is the cell's own evidence that it began against an undecided docket — the ordering a date-only disposition cannot establish after the fact. `unavailable` says the poll established nothing and the cell ran on the stored-snapshot gates alone. Null on evaluate cells, on cells minted before the poll existed, and wherever no poll ran.
